# Local Orchestration Generated Solution context

Direct execution is the universal Local Development Profile. The file-based
Aspire AppHost is optional development orchestration, while Compose is a
headless bounded single-host projection over the immutable container artifact.

Both projections consume the accepted Deployment Manifest. They preserve
external configuration, dependency readiness, one-shot Migrator completion,
health checks, and graceful shutdown. Compose does not claim high availability,
cluster recovery, rolling deployment, or autoscaling.
